verdict.rationale: Temporal's evidence pack shows it as infrastructure for building durable AI agent workflows (docs on agentic loops, LLM tool calls as Activities) and an MCP docs server for agents to query documentation, but nothing shows a built-in AI assistant inside the Temporal product (CLI/Web UI/Cloud console) to which a user can delegate tasks. This is a fair question for a dev-tool platform (many now ship copilot-style assistants), so the axis applies, and no evidence of such a feature exists.
